auftrag: Read the email from Agent Wren. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: You are one of eight new trainees at the Agent Academy.
Please come tomorrow at nine o'clock.
The Academy is behind the old bookshop in Fox Lane.
Ring the brass bell twice, then say your name.
Meet me in the Map Room on the second floor.
Bring your ID card and this email, but please leave your phone at home.
Nobody may know about the Academy, so do not talk about it on the bus.
Something very important is missing, and we need your help.
I cannot tell you more in an email.

raetsel.frage: Tap the sentence that tells you how to get in.
raetsel.hilfe2: It is in the first paragraph.

optionen: behind the old bookshop in Fox Lane
on the second floor of a bus
raetsel.hilfe2: The place has a name: Fox Lane.

raetsel.frage: True or false? “The trainees may bring their phones.”
raetsel.hilfe1: Find the sentence about the phone.
raetsel.hilfe2: Wren says: leave your phone at ...
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: What does "missing" mean in the text?
raetsel.hilfe1: Think about the sentence: Something very important is missing, and we need your help.
raetsel.hilfe2: If you help, you can find it again.

raetsel.frage: Read the short message. Choose the right words.
raetsel.text: Agent Wren ___ an email yesterday. Today I ___ it again. Tomorrow I ___ the Map Room.
raetsel.hilfe1: Look at the time words: yesterday, today, tomorrow.
raetsel.hilfe2: Yesterday = it is finished. Tomorrow = it has not happened yet.
